prompt: fewest boundaries conceded in T20 death overs since 2020

events.sql:
WITH base AS (
            SELECT 1 AS _grp,
                   d.bowler_id AS bowler_id,
                   sum(d.counts_for_over::INT)::INTEGER AS balls_bowled,
                   sum(d.runs_conceded_bowler)::INTEGER AS runs_conceded,
                   sum(d.bowler_wicket_count)::INTEGER AS wickets,
                   sum(d.is_dot_ball::INT)::INTEGER AS dots,
                   sum(d.is_four::INT)::INTEGER AS fours_conceded,
                   sum(d.is_six::INT)::INTEGER AS sixes_conceded,
                   count(DISTINCT d.match_id || ':' || d.innings_no)::INTEGER AS innings,
                   count(DISTINCT d.match_id)::INTEGER AS matches
            FROM deliveries d
            
            WHERE NOT d.is_super_over AND d.format IN (?) AND d.gender = ? AND d.match_date >= ? AND d.competition IN (?) AND d.phase = ?
            GROUP BY d.bowler_id
        ), joined AS (SELECT * FROM base)
        SELECT j.bowler_id,
               p.unique_name AS player_name,
               j.balls_bowled,
               j.runs_conceded,
               j.wickets,
               j.dots,
               j.fours_conceded,
               j.sixes_conceded,
               j.innings,
               j.matches,
               CASE WHEN coalesce((balls_bowled), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(6.0 * (runs_conceded) / (balls_bowled), 2) END AS economy,
               CASE WHEN coalesce((wickets), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(1.0 * (runs_conceded) / (wickets), 2) END AS average,
               CASE WHEN coalesce((wickets), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(1.0 * (balls_bowled) / (wickets), 2) END AS strike_rate,
               CASE WHEN coalesce((balls_bowled), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * (dots) / (balls_bowled), 2) END AS dot_pct,
               CASE WHEN coalesce((balls_bowled), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(100.0 * (fours_conceded + sixes_conceded) / (balls_bowled), 2) END AS boundary_conceded_pct,
               ((balls_bowled / 6)::INTEGER || '.' || (balls_bowled % 6)::VARCHAR) AS overs,
               count(*) OVER ()::INTEGER AS _qualified,
               (SELECT count(*) FROM base)::INTEGER AS _considered,
               (SELECT coalesce(sum(balls_bowled), 0) FROM base)::BIGINT AS _scanned
        FROM joined j
        LEFT JOIN players p ON p.player_id = j.bowler_id
        WHERE balls_bowled >= 300 AND innings >= 1
        ORDER BY boundary_conceded_pct ASC NULLS LAST
        LIMIT ?

metrics.balls_bowled: Legal balls bowled: excludes both wides and no-balls, a different denominator from a batter's balls faced.
metrics.runs_conceded: Runs charged to the bowler: off the bat, plus wides, plus no-ball penalties. Byes and leg-byes are NOT charged to the bowler.
metrics.wickets: Wickets credited to the bowler. Run outs, obstruction, retirements and timed out are dismissals but are not the bowler's.
metrics.dots: Balls off which the batting side scored nothing at all. Note this is the TEAM's dot, so it is not the same count as a batter's: a wide is never a dot here, but a ball that went for leg-byes is a dot for the batter and not for the bowler.
metrics.fours_conceded: Fours hit off this bowler that reached the boundary, with the same non_boundary exclusion as a batter's fours.
metrics.sixes_conceded: Sixes hit off this bowler that reached the boundary.
metrics.innings: Distinct innings, counted as match plus innings number.
metrics.economy: Runs conceded per over, where an over is six legal balls.
metrics.average: Runs conceded divided by wickets taken. Undefined (null), not zero, for a bowler who has taken none.
metrics.strike_rate: Legal balls bowled per wicket taken -- for a bowler this is a rate of striking, so LOWER is better, the opposite of a batter's strike rate.
metrics.dot_pct: Percentage of legal balls off which no run of any kind was scored.
metrics.boundary_conceded_pct: Fours and sixes conceded as a percentage of LEGAL balls bowled. The denominator excludes wides and no-balls, so it is not the same denominator as a batter's boundary %, which counts a no-ball as a ball faced. This follows the economy-rate convention: a boundary off a no-ball is charged to the bowler, while the no-ball itself does not count towards his over.
metrics.overs: Overs bowled, written O.B -- '4.3' is four overs and three balls, not four and a half overs.

notes: wickets are bowler-credited only: run outs are excluded, as on a scorecard
